how_a_driven_round_is_recorded.the_rule_it_must_pass: transcriptIsSelfConsistent(): every ALL-CAPS label printed at the start of an output line must appear in the pasted program. .p fails this — it prints AMOUNT_EL_TEXT_STATUS and its pasted program never prints that label, so the program shown is not the program run. how_a_driven_round_is_recorded.what_the_rule_cannot_do: A transcript printing no ALL-CAPS labels can be checked against nothing. That returns `unusable`, and unusable counts as NOT supported rather than as unknown — a claim present and unverifiable is not silence. Recorded here rather than left to be discovered, because a vacuous pass reads exactly like a measurement.
